title: Offsite Payment Instrument
description: A basic offsite payment instrument. Can be inherited by a handler's instrument schema to define handler-specific display details or more complex credential structures.

type.description: Indicates this is an offsite payment instrument.

display.description: Display information for this offsite payment instrument, provided by the business. SHOULD include at least one of `instructions`, `instructions_image_url`, or `link` so the buyer knows how to complete the payment.

description.description: An optional rich text description to display to the user (e.g., 'Cash on Delivery', 'Pay by Invoice').

instructions.description: Instructions to the buyer on how to complete the offsite payment.

instructions_image_url.description: URI to an image conveying how to complete the offsite payment (e.g., rendered payment instructions or a QR code for the buyer to scan).

link.description: A link the buyer can follow to complete the offsite payment or view further instructions.
